notes.title: 📢 Important Announcement to Players of Goi: Spooky Run
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307299/e690203564965fe5b276902ae649936ab4456006.jpg[/img]
The development team of Goi: Spooky Run would like to inform everyone that the game’s Live Service system will officially end on September 1, 2024. To ensure that all in-game data, such as character information, in-game currency, and items, remain intact, we recommend all players log in to the game at least once by August 31, 2024, at 11:59 PM (GMT+7) to prevent any data loss. If you do not log in before this change, your data may be lost.

Even though the Live Service system will be discontinued, players can still enjoy Goi: Spooky Run as usual. We greatly appreciate all your feedback and continued support.

Sincerely,  
The Goi: Spooky Run Development Team

notes.title: New Dance Move !!! Let's dance like crazy to celebrate Songkran! 🎉
notes.content:
New Dance Move !!! Let's dance like crazy to celebrate Songkran! 🎉

Get a free new dance moves and unlock a super special dance move price! 
Just complete the mission according to the conditions from NPC Songkran Guy.

🕹️ Mission Conditions:
1.You can obtain the dance move "Shift back please!" by talking to NPC Songkran guy.
2.After obtaining the "Shift back please!" dance move, you can talk to NPC Songkran guy and must pay 20 Soulmedals to obtain the "Let’s Planting and Dancing" dance move.
3.Once you have obtained the "Let’s Planting and Dancing" dance move, talk to NPC Songkran guy to start the mission to dance in a "Light Area". You must complete the dance mission in a Light Area for 2 minutes and must finish the game (no quitting during play; otherwise, the time will not be counted). The dance moves that can be used for this mission are: Happy Dance, Shaking Shoulder, Shift back please!, Let's planting and dancing. Emotes that will not count towards the time include Angry Emote, Cry Emote, Curtsey Emote, Hi Emote, Greeting Emote. After successfully completing the dance mission in The Light Area, talk to NPC Songkran guy again to receive the "Put some powder" dance move.
4.After obtaining the "Put some powder" dance move, players can purchase the "Chicken Pecking" dance move at a special price of 555 Marbles, reduced from the regular price of 1,110 Marbles.

📅 Event Period:
April 11, 2024 - May 31, 2024 until 11:59 PM (GMT+7) 🕹️

notes.title: Compensation for Players Who Have Previously Purchased Our Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307299/2d480591f088c67317fbb659405b47736b47a89f.jpg[/img]
We would like to express our sincere gratitude to the players who have previously purchased our game. As the team plans to transition the game to Free-to-Play format, those who have purchased our game will receive compensation items.
1. 5,000 Marbles
2. 500,000 Coins
3. Navigator Set (Hat / Outfit)

Steps to Receive Items
1. The team will automatically add items to players who have previously purchased before within 14 days.
2. Each user will receive items only once.
3. If any player who has purchased the game does not receive items in the game, you can contact the team at support@mygg-game.com


The team apologizes for the inconvenience caused and appreciates everyone's support.

notes.title: [17/3/23] A TEMPORARY SERVER SHUTDOWN
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307299/95e84c53d15392c6c40d4c0f373091ed8f6c2779.jpg[/img]

[b]🔥 A temporary server shutdown 🔥[/b]
From 17th March 2023, 7.30 PM onward, the game will start for major maintenance.
.
We encounter a problem that players get kicked out from the server while playing and other minor bugs.
We received some feedback and we will not sit on it.
To resolve these problems, we decided to temporarily shutdown the server.

We really appreciate and feel grateful to all players who support our game.
However, after solving all the problems. We will be back for full service again.
For the players who purchase our game and play, after returning to service.
We will definitely give special rewards to everyone.

We’ll keep you posted.  Please follow us on FB: [url=https://www.facebook.com/MYGG.GOI]Goi: Let’s Play Together[/url]
